title: Make AppFlow event type identities stable across translation units
body: The existing `AUTO_MESSAGE_TYPE()` values for AppFlow events resolved differently across translation units because their header source paths differed, so EventBus subscriptions missed successfully published events. I replaced them with stable named `StableMessageTypeId` values to make the edge-event tests pass. Derive header event identity from the declared type name rather than translation-unit path.

title: Provide one aggregate target for all VIXEN codegen checks
body: The witness requires every `*_check` target, but I had to enumerate 22 targets from `build/wsl/build.ninja` and pass the full list manually. Add a stable aggregate target or a supported command that runs the complete generated-code check set.

title: Derive VIXEN schema catalogue input from the paired Undertow worktree
body: The documented standalone configure required an explicit `-DVIXEN_SCHEMA_CATALOG=<undertow>/core/src/Undertow.Authoring/Schema/schemas.json`. Resolve the paired Undertow catalogue automatically or provide a worktree-aware configure preset.

title: Resolve VIXEN FetchContent cache from the current worktree by default
body: The configure/build commands required `VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=<this-worktree>/.tmp/fetch` to prevent a second dependency cache from being created. Derive the cache from the configured worktree or include the environment in the preset.

title: Provide a canonical VIXEN build-directory invocation for lane worktrees
body: A CMake command issued from `VIXEN/` used the wrong relative `build/wsl` location and failed before the target ran; the correct invocation depended on the repository-root working directory and its preset paths. Add a worktree-aware configure/build wrapper or document the required directory and build path in one place.
